summary: The JSON pretty-printing feature is implemented but not verified: I could not run tests, per the instructions. Changes: a JSONHighlighter class in rich/highlighter.py; a new rich/json.py with the JSON renderable and a guarded __main__ entry; six json.* theme styles in rich/default_styles.py; Console.print_json in rich/console.py; package-level print_json in rich/__init__.py; docs (a "Printing JSON" section in console.rst, reference/json.rst, toctree entry); a CHANGELOG line under Unreleased; and two new tests appended to tests/test_console.py and tests/test_rich_print.py. Nothing is committed. Choices: overflow is set to Python None rather than the string "ignore"; the console import in the main block sits under the main guard. The new test expectations were derived by hand and have not been run, so test_print_json may need its ANSI sequences checked against actual output.
